**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when parsing AI [...] fails / there's no way to [...]

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen (new API, new parsing option, new supported symbology, catalog generation improvement, etc.).

**Relevant Application Identifier(s) / GS1 spec reference**
If applicable, list the AI(s) concerned (e.g. AI 01, AI 8005) or link to the relevant section of the GS1 General Specifications (`ref.gs1.org`).

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

**Additional context**
Add any other context, sample barcode strings, or references about the feature request here.
